encoding.notes: Hand-specified instruction bytes, independent of TokenTable and test/helpers/tokens.js. Print=0x0476, integer=0x003e, /=0xffec, Mod=0xffd4. Negative constants are signed raw words. Source is a readable semantic equivalent, not an exported ASCII/binary pair.

evidence.notes: Op_Div normalizes signs, computes a 32-bit unsigned quotient, then applies NEG.L without checking overflow. The INT_MIN / -1 result therefore retains bit pattern 0x80000000.
